scope: Exact supplied API keys, runtime service secrets and injected GitHub token; values never printed or persisted.
timing: After final source/build/review files existed and before their final metadata commit; added metadata contains only these counts and public provenance.
method: scripts/scan-credential-leaks.mjs; hidden stdin, terminal echo disabled; plaintext/base64 candidates and retained Git blobs.
limits: A string scan supports absence of these exact values; it is not a comprehensive security certification.
